Your missionTo support the Group's growth ambitions, EP Power Grit Group is seeking a Product Manager (m/f/d).

The Product Manager is responsible for the strategic development and lifecycle management of the company's product portfolio. The role ensures that customer requirements, market developments, technical capabilities and commercial objectives are translated into competitive products and sustainable growth opportunities.

The responsibilities for this role will be:
Product Portfolio Management
• Own and continuously develop the global product portfolio across blasting abrasives and industrial minerals.
• Manage the complete product lifecycle from product introduction to phase-out.
• Define portfolio priorities and support portfolio simplification.
• Monitor product profitability and recommend portfolio improvements.

Product Development & Innovation
• Identify customer needs and translate them into new product concepts.
• Lead product development projects in collaboration with Operations, Procurement and Quality.
• Support the introduction of sustainable and innovative product solutions.
• Evaluate new raw materials, applications and technologies.

Market & Customer Insights
• Analyze market trends, customer requirements and competitive developments.
• Build structured customer and application knowledge.
• Identify new applications and market opportunities.
• Develop business cases for new products and portfolio extensions.

Commercial Product Management
• Develop compelling product positioning and customer value propositions.
• Support value-based pricing together with Sales.
• Prepare product documentation, technical data sheets and application guides.
• Support strategic customer projects, key tenders and technical presentations.
• Deliver product and application training to Sales teams and distributors.

Cross-functional Collaboration
• Act as the central interface between Sales, Operations, Procurement, Supply Chain and Quality.
• Ensure customer requirements are reflected in product specifications and manufacturing capabilities.
• Coordinate product launches and product changes across all functions.
• Support continuous product improvement initiatives.

Your profile
• 5–10 years of experience in Product Management, Product Development, Portfolio Management or Technical Sales within an industrial B2B environment.
• Experience in abrasives, industrial minerals, construction materials, steel, chemicals or related industries is advantageous.
• Strong understanding of product lifecycle management.
• Commercial mindset combined with technical understanding.
• Experience working closely with Sales and Operations.
• Strong analytical and project management skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent English required; German advantageous.

Why us?"For big ideas with strong partners. Now and in the future." This is our claim, which we stride to fulfil every day anew for our customers in many countries around the world. This commitment shapes your future working environment and creates success together. We are future-oriented, international, and diverse. Your personal and professional development is as important to us, as well as a good work-life balance, a flexible working hours model and an attractive remuneration package.

About usWe are EP Power Grit GmbH based in Oberhausen and specialized in abrasives and industrial minerals based on slags, minerals, glass and other raw materials. The environmentally friendly products are effectively used for surface cleaning in industry, on buildings and ships, for water jet cutting or as decorative building materials. Smart logistics services tailored to customer needs promise additional benefits. With proven production facilities, we produce high-quality abrasives at our sites in Germany and, since December 2022, at additional sites in Belgium, the Netherlands and Finland. We are a subsidiary of EP Power Minerals GmbH and thus part of the Central European energy group Energetický a průmyslový holding (EPH).

We are looking for a scientist to support our Spatial Biology Unit within Technology Research Center to start as soon as possible. We are an interdisciplinary team of scientists, PhD students, and research assistants with diverse background, including cancer biology, neuroscience, and immunology. Our Unit supports projects of TRON, as well as collaborations with industrial and academic partners by providing expertise in histological assays, spatial proteomics, and spatial transcriptomics. We analyze and validate novel biomarkers in spatial context, deepen our understanding of the tumor microenvironment, and investigate the biodistribution and expression of mRNA-based vaccines and other immunotherapeutic modalities. The successful candidate will develop novel methods and analysis pipelines for spatial proteomics and transcriptomics, support projects involving data analysis of multiplex and high-plex immunohistochemistry (IHC) and spatial transcriptomics, contribute to exciting ongoing and novel projects in high-dimensional tumour profiling to translate those findings to clinical settings. The candidate will collaborate with experts across multiple disciplines to advance the projects.
Implement, optimize, and apply robust and reproducible analysis pipelines for spatial omics data
Develop novel multi-modal data integration methods for spatial multi-omics assays
Integrate in-house generated data with publicly available spatial and single-cell atlases
Support and train scientists and PhD students in spatial omics data analysis
Collaborate in multidisciplinary project teams with academic and industrial partners to identify novel biomarkers and therapeutic targets
Review literature for emerging methods, datasets, and discoveries in the field of spatial omics
Present and discuss in internal meetings and international conferences, write R&D reports and scientific publications

Ph.D. degree in a relevant scientific discipline (e.g. Biology, Bioinformatics, Computer Science)
Demonstrated scientific expertise in the analysis of spatial omics data
Good knowledge of cancer biology and immunology
Experience in leading research projects in a multidisciplinary environmentStrong programming skills, particularly in Python and R, with experience in spatial data analysis and machine learning with an emphasize on spatial proteomics
Experience in microscopy image analysis is essential
Flexibility and adaptability to changing projects and organizational priorities
Strong communication skills in English

Enthusiasm and curiosity for the diverse activities of our research institute as well as the ability to work in a team completes your profile.
A dynamic, innovative and creative research environment
An open, collegial and cordial working atmosphere in a respectful corporate culture
A high degree of diversity in the workforce
Access to GPU-accelerated HPC cluster and labs with cutting-edge sequencing and imaging technologies
Performance-related remuneration and other benefits
The opportunity for personalised further training
Job ticket (Deutschlandticket) incl. employer allowance
Bike leasing (Businessbike)
The opportunity for hybrid working

TRON is an internationally recognised institute for application-oriented research. We combine the strengths of academic research with the requirements of quality-controlled industrial developments. At TRON, we share a common mission to develop innovative solutions for the immunotherapeutic treatment of cancer, infectious diseases and other serious diseases with high medical need.

TRON was founded in Mainz in 2010 and works in close cooperation with universities and hospitals as well as with regional, national and international research institutions and pharmaceutical companies.

As part of our team, you have the opportunity to be at the cutting edge of translational science with us.

If all this appeals to you, we look forward to getting to know you.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Computer Vision and Multimodal AI for the Early Detection of Parkinson’s (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research with excellence in teaching. Each year, more than half a million patients receive inpatient and outpatient care at the UKB. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranks first among university hospitals in North Rhine-Westphalia and second nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. Institute has named the UKB “Germany’s Training Champion” and “Germany’s Most Attractive Employer” for the fourth consecutive year.

The following full-time (38.5 hours/week) position is to be filled as soon as possible at the Center of Neurology of the University Hospital Bonn:

Postdoctoral Researcher in Computer Vision and Multimodal AI for the Early Detection of Parkinson’s Disease (m/w/d)

The position is fixed-term until 30 September 2028 due to the duration of the research project.

Parkinson’s disease is usually diagnosed only after substantial neurodegeneration has already occurred. Subtle changes in movement, facial expression and speech may emerge years earlier, but current clinical assessments are not designed to detect and quantify them at scale. We believe that computer vision and multimodal AI can help close this gap - and that meaningful progress requires researchers who want to apply cutting-edge methods to a major clinical challenge.

Our goal is to develop objective and scalable digital tools for the early detection and monitoring of Parkinson’s disease. We combine video-based analysis of gait, balance, facial expression and limb movements with speech, touchscreen and wearable sensor data. A particular focus is on individuals with isolated REM sleep behavior disorder, who are at high risk of developing Parkinson’s disease or related neurodegenerative disorders.

The group of Prof. Dr. Michael Sommerauer at the Center of Neurology at the University Hospital Bonn and the German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE) is seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to join our interdisciplinary team.

The successful candidate will take a leading role in the development of the computer vision components of bradyMX, our multimodal digital motor assessment platform. The position is embedded in the ERC-funded Re-START PD research program and offers the opportunity to work with unique, deeply phenotyped clinical cohorts and longitudinal datasets. Rather than developing methods in isolation, you will work closely with clinicians and neuroscientists to translate methodological advances into tools that may improve patient stratification, clinical trials and, ultimately, the way Parkinson’s disease is detected.

Please submit your application as a single PDF, including: 

• a cover letter describing your scientific interests and motivation for joining the group 

• a curriculum vitae including a publication list 

• contact details for at least two referees

Your responsibilities:

- Lead the development of computer vision methods for quantifying subtle motor abnormalities from clinical video recordings
- Develop robust pipelines for human pose estimation, facial and body landmark detection, movement segmentation, tracking, feature extraction and automated quality control
- Design and evaluate machine-learning and deep-learning models for the analysis of gait, balance, facial expression and upper- and lower-limb movements
- Investigate temporal modelling, representation learning and interpretable movement features for the detection and monitoring of early motor dysfunction
- Integrate video-derived features with complementary digital modalities such as speech, touchscreen tasks, inertial sensors and clinical assessments
- Evaluate model robustness and generalizability across participants, recording conditions, devices and international study sites
- Work closely with the clinical research team on study design, data collection, annotation strategies and the interpretation of model outputs
- Prepare scientific manuscripts, present results at international conferences and contribute to grant applications
- Support the supervision of doctoral, Master’s and medical students

Your profile:

- - A doctoral degree in computer vision, machine learning, computer science, biomedical engineering, medical informatics or a closely related discipline
- Strong experience in machine learning and deep learning for image, video or human movement analysis
- Excellent programming skills in Python and practical experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX
- Experience in one or more of the following areas: human pose estimation, motion tracking, action recognition, temporal modelling, self-supervised learning, multimodal learning or domain adaptation
- A sound understanding of experimental design, quantitative model evaluation and reproducible research practices
- Experience with version control and collaborative software development; knowledge of containerized workflows and high-performance computing is an advantage
- Interest in translating methodological advances into clinically meaningful applications; previous experience in Parkinson’s disease or medical research is welcome but not required
- A high degree of scientific curiosity, independence and commitment to rigorous research
- Strong communication skills and enthusiasm for working in an interdisciplinary and international environment
- Very good command of written and spoken English; German language skills are not required

What we offer: 

- The opportunity to lead an innovative research project at the intersection of computer vision, multimodal AI, neurology and digital health
- Access to unique, deeply phenotyped cohorts of individuals at risk of Parkinson’s disease, healthy controls and patients with early Parkinson’s disease
- Rich video, sensor and clinical datasets collected using standardized multimodal assessment protocols
- A direct path from methodological development to external validation and clinically relevant application
- Close collaboration with neurologists, neuroscientists, and international experts in Parkinson’s disease and digital biomarkers
- An excellent research environment at the University Hospital Bonn, the University of Bonn and the German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases
- Access to modern computational infrastructure and support for reproducible data analysis and software development
- Strong support for scientific publications, conference participation, grant applications and the development of an independent academic profile
- Opportunities to supervise junior researchers and contribute to a growing interdisciplinary research group
- Responsible and diverse: A position with plenty of room for creativity and responsibility within a supportive and collegial team
- Fair compensation: Pay according to the TV-L collective agreement TV-L (EG13), including annual bonus and company pension scheme
- Family-friendly flexibility: Flexible working time models, access to a place in our company daycare center, and programs supporting employees returning from parental leave
- Smart commuting: Excellent connection to the SWB public transport network
- Supported development: Individual training opportunities through courses, e-learning programs, and coaching sessions
- Structured onboarding: A systematic introduction to your new role and team
- Healthy at work: A wide range of health and wellness programs, plus free membership at the UKB fitness studio
- Employee benefits: Access to discounted offers for employees (corporate benefits)

We are committed to diversity and equal opportunities. Our goal is to increase the proportion of women in areas where women are underrepresented and to particularly promote their careers. We therefore urge relevantly qualified women to apply. Applications are treated in accordance with the State Equal Opportunities Act. Applications from suitable people with proven severe disabilities and those of equal status are particularly welcome.

Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz (JGU) is one of the largest universities in Germany. Thanks to its location in the Rhine-Main science region, the university can unfold to its full potential and showcase its innovative power and dynamism. Its status as a comprehensive university allows for multidisciplinary learning and teaching and has great potential for internationally renowned, interdisciplinary research. Almost all of its institutes are located on a single campus close to the Mainz city center - creating a lively academic culture for researchers, teaching staff, and students from every continent.

Academic staff member (Postdoc): Plant RNA Biology

The Wachter group investigates the molecular mechanisms and biological functions of alternative RNA splicing in plants (https://mps-imp.biologie.uni-mainz.de/). Our recent work has identified novel components of the plant splicing-regulatory code, including structured mRNA elements (e.g., https://doi.org/10.1111/tpj.71060 ) and position-dependent functions of pyrimidine motifs (https://doi.org/10.1111/tpj.16739). By combining these functional studies with global profiling approaches, we are building a framework to understand and engineer alternative splicing in the context of plant development and stress responses.

As a member of our international research team, you will examine the regulation and functional impact of splicing decisions controlled by polypyrimidine tract-binding proteins (PTBs), a family of key splicing regulators in plants and animals. Your work will build on our previous findings on PTB functions in alternative splicing and on recent results from ongoing transcriptome-wide approaches, including splicing pattern profiling, iCLIP, and TRIBE. You will further develop these analysis pipelines and integrate the resulting datasets to define the role of this central component of splicing control in the model plant Arabidopsis thaliana. The new insights from these mechanistic studies will be linked to physiological PTB functions we previously observed, including ABA-dependent seed germination and drought tolerance. The overarching goal of this project is to establish the molecular connections between PTB functions and key traits of stress physiology, thereby laying the groundwork for novel strategies to enhance plant resilience. This work is supported by extensive expertise, various core facilities, and a completely new research infrastructure.

Tackling critical questions on PTB functions in A. thaliana using a multidisciplinary approach, which integrates molecular biology, RNA biochemistry, and plant stress physiology
Applying state-of-the-art techniques for gene-specific and genome-wide analyses of RNA biology
Developing an integrated framework to decipher PTB’s role in splicing and its downstream physiological outcomes, with a particular focus on drought stress
Assisting with lab organisation and other general tasks
Contributing to teaching activities for Bachelor's and Master's students within our group
Supervising PhD students and other group members
Presenting your research findings in oral and written form, including conference contributions, reports, and manuscripts

A successfully completed scientific university degree in Biology or in a related field
A successfully completed doctorate (PhD) in molecular plant biology or RNA biology
Experience with a spectrum of molecular methods
Experience in plant (stress) physiology is a plus, but not mandatory
Teaching experience is a plus, but not mandatory
Very good English language skills (at least level B2); German language skills are a plus, but not mandatory

A fascination for science, very good communication and teamwork skills

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/x) – First-Principles Core-Level Spectroscopy of Functional Interfaces (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time, full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for 1

Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/x) – First-Principles Core-Level Spectroscopy of Functional Interfaces

The successful applicant (m/f/x) will join the research group of Prof. Silvana Botti at the Research Center Future Energy Materials and Systems (RC FEMS) and the Ruhr University Bochum (RUB). The group develops first-principles methods to describe electronic excitations, spectroscopic signatures, and structure–property relations in materials and at functional interfaces.

Core-level spectroscopies — X-ray absorption (XAS/XANES), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and core-loss electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS/ELNES) — are among the few experimental probes that are element-specific and, at the same time, sensitive to the local chemical environment of the excited atom. Because the core hole is strictly localised, the resulting spectral fine structure encodes coordination, charge transfer, oxidation state, and local magnetic order at the single-atom level. Turning this sensitivity into quantitative structural information, however, requires theory: the interpretation of measured spectra rests on the accurate ab initio description of core-hole effects, core-exciton binding, multiplet structure, and electronic correlation. Existing approaches have been developed and validated largely for bulk compounds, whereas the systems of interest for energy conversion and catalysis are surfaces, interfaces, and defects, where symmetry breaking, hybridisation, and local charge redistribution reshape the spectra. The aim of this position is to close that gap. The successful candidate will develop and extend first-principles methods for core-level spectroscopy and establish their predictive accuracy for functional interfaces, including systems containing correlated and magnetic transition-metal elements. The developments will be implemented in existing electronic-structure and spectroscopy codes, released as documented open-source software, and validated against experimental spectra measured by partners at RUB and within RC FEMS. In perspective, these methods will provide the basis for using computed core-level spectra as fingerprints of local atomic arrangements at chemically complex alloy surfaces — an application currently being prepared with experimental groups on campus — so that the candidate will help shape the scientific direction of a planned collaborative research programme from the start. The newly founded Research Center focuses on developing innovative materials and systems for sustainable energy applications. The center’s research areas include photovoltaics, thermoelectricity, energy storage, fuel cells, and sustainable chemical processes, among others. Its interdisciplinary approach involves collaborations between physicists, chemists, engineers, and material scientists to address the challenges of transitioning to a low-carbon economy. The center also offers opportunities for graduate students and postdoctoral researchers to participate in cutting-edge research projects and receive advanced training in the field of energy materials and systems. The chair of Prof. Botti is affiliated with the Faculty of Physics and Astronomy of the Ruhr University Bochum. This faculty is a leading research and teaching institution in the fields of experimental and theoretical physics and astronomy, with a focus on condensed matter physics, astrophysics, and particle physics.

Scope: part-time, full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 2 Years
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-10-20

Your tasks:

The successful candidate (f/m/x) will

- develop and extend ab initio methods for core-level spectroscopy — X-ray absorption and core-loss EELS near-edge structure, as well as core-level binding-energy shifts in photoemission — with particular attention to core-hole effects, core-exciton binding, and multiplet structure
- extend the description of core-level excitations from bulk compounds to surfaces, interfaces, adsorbates, and defects, and quantify how symmetry breaking, hybridisation, and local charge transfer modify the near-edge spectral features
- treat correlated and magnetic transition-metal elements with methods beyond standard density functional theory, such as dynamical mean-field theory or multiplet ligand-field approaches, and establish for which systems and spectral features this level of theory is actually required
- implement the developments in established electronic-structure and spectroscopy codes, and release them as documented, maintainable open-source software usable by others in the community
- benchmark computed spectra against experimental data in close collaboration with spectroscopy and electron-microscopy partners at RUB and within RC FEMS
- help prepare the extension of these developments to chemically complex surfaces and to forthcoming collaborative research proposals, including preliminary calculations and proof-of-concept studies
- publish results in peer-reviewed journals, present them at international conferences, and contribute to the training of doctoral and master’s students in the group

Your profile:

Required qualifications:

- A master and PhD in Physics
- A strong background in condensed matter physics and in the first-principles electronic-structure theory of solids
- Strong knowledge of quantum mechanics and of the theory of electronic excitations in materials, including core-level excitations and the interaction between the core hole and the excited electron
- Demonstrated expertise in the theory and simulation of at least one core-level spectroscopy, such as X-ray absorption, X-ray photoemission, or core-loss electron energy-loss spectroscopy
- Working experience with methods for correlated or open-shell systems beyond standard density functional theory, for example dynamical mean-field theory, Hubbard-corrected functionals, or multiplet and ligand-field approaches
- High-level programming skills in Fortran and/or Python, and practical experience with established electronic-structure or spectroscopy codes (e.g., VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT, SIESTA, RSPt, TRIQS)
- Demonstrated experience in the development of computational methods and scientific software, documented for example by contributions to a community code or by a released open-source package. We are looking for researchers who develop methods and codes — not users. Experience limited to running standard codes will not be considered.
- Demonstrated ability to carry out independent research, evidenced by publications in peer-reviewed journals
- Good command of English, both written and spoken

At the Faculty of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Institute of Circuits and Systems, the Chair of Highly-Parallel VLSI Systems and Neuro-Microelectronics offers a position as

Research Associate / PhD Student / PostDoc (m/f/x)

(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)

starting as soon as possible. The position is limited until May 31, 2029. The period of employment is governed by the Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). The position offers the chance to obtain further academic qualification (usually PhD / habilitation thesis). Balancing family and career is an important issue. The position is generally suitable for candidates seeking part-time employment. Please indicate the request in your application.

State-of-the-art AI systems depend heavily on models, providers and hardware from the U.S. and China, which represents a big challenge of Europe’s sovereignty for AI model development and deployment (e.g., trustworthiness, dependability, performance, modularity). The Horizon Europe project OptimAIse (Optimising Performance and Trust for Integrity-driven Modular genAI Software Engineering) addresses these challenges by delivering a scalable, modular, and interoperable reference architecture that leverages European hardware to enable efficient and simplified large language model deployments. The SpiNNaker2 hardware, developed by TU Dresden and commercialized by SpiNNcloud, is one of Europe’s most promising alternatives for the energy-efficient serving of LLMs. SpiNNaker2 is a massively parallel architecture with locally dense compute and globally sparse and low-latency communication, ideal to realize efficient AI models by leveraging sparse and event-based computing.

The candidate will develop and adopt LLMs for the SpiNNaker2 hardware. The models shall be implemented on the hardware using an existing software stack and optimized with ML compilers such as MLIR. Besides applying known approaches such as Mixture-of-Experts, the candidate shall follow the state of the art of efficient language models and try novel approaches on SpiNNaker2. In addition, the work will derive requirements and recommendation for next-generation AI hardware such as Spinnaker3, thus guiding the future of efficient AI systems.

Tasks: 

- scientific research in efficient language models and their hardware deployment
- development and training of sparse and communication avoiding GenAI models optimized for SpiNNaker2 hardware
- implementation of GenAI models (resp. their layers) on SpiNNaker2 using ML compilers (e.g., MLIR)
- presentation and publication of research results in top-tier conferences/journals
- collaboration in European project OptimAIse, integrating GenAI models on SpiNNaker2 for use-case demonstrators

Requirements: 

- university degree (Master’s or equivalent) in computer science, electrical engineering, machine learning or related fields of expertise
- good understanding of LLMs and how they are processed on AI hardware for inference
- very good programming skills (e.g., C++, Python)
- good written and spoken English skills
- high motivation and ability to work independently and in teams
- excellent skills and practical experience in one or more of the following research areas is beneficial:
- compiler frameworks (LLVM, MLIR)
- embedded software development
- computer and accelerator architectures
- parallel and distributed computing

We offer: 

- the opportunity to collaborate within a diverse team of multi-domain experts at HPSN chair
- access to the world’s-largest brain-inspired supercomputer SpiNNcloud
- access to TUD’s HPC environment for ML training
- flexible arrangements for work hours to support a good work-life balance
- 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 5-day workweek)
- extensive opportunities for professional development and continuing education
- health care and sports programs offered by TUD
- a discounted job ticket (also available as a Deutschlandticket)
- participation in the supplementary pension scheme for employees in the public sector via VBL (Federal and State Government Employees Retirement Fund)

TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment.

Application:

Please submit your detailed application with the usual documents (Cover letter, CV, degree certificate) quoting the reference code HPSN_OptimAIse_2026 by October 20, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de by sending it as a single pdf file to christian.mayr@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:christian.mayr@tu-dresden.de) or to:

TU Dresden, Chair of Highly-Parallel VLSI Systems and Neuro-Microelectronics, Prof. Christian Mayr, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.

Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.

TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.

About the role

Münster, Germany · Part-time

The Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator will provide executive, administrative and project coordination support to the CFO. Based in Germany and working closely with the CFO in France, you will help keep financial administration, corporate governance and cross-border operational matters moving to completion.

This is a practical coordination role for someone who is organised, persistent and comfortable following up with banks, lawyers, tax advisers, notaries, corporate service providers and internal teams. You will coordinate documents, signatures, banking administration, KYC and AML requests, legal entity changes and board formalities across the Atari Group.

You do not need to be an accountant or a technical finance specialist. You do need to be reliable with sensitive information, comfortable with formal processes and willing to chase the right people until an item is complete.

What you’ll do

- Provide day-to-day executive and administrative support to the CFO, coordinating priorities across Germany, France and the US.
- Coordinate the preparation, circulation, approval and execution of corporate documents, board resolutions, powers of attorney and other legal or finance documentation.
- Manage signature workflows, monitor outstanding actions and ensure documents are signed, returned and stored on time.
- Coordinate banking administration, including account openings and closures, bank mandates, signatory updates and KYC/AML requests.
- Maintain accurate corporate records and legal entity documentation, ensuring information is complete, current and easy to retrieve.
- Support legal entity shutdowns, entity administration and related projects by coordinating actions across Finance, Legal, tax advisers, banks and external service providers.
- Liaise with banks, external legal counsel, tax lawyers, corporate service providers, notaries and local finance teams on administrative and corporate matters.
- Coordinate board minutes, governance records, approvals, formalities and other recurring corporate requirements.
- Support finance-related administrative work, including gathering information, tracking deadlines, maintaining records and coordinating deliverables.
- Act as a project coordinator for cross-functional finance and governance workstreams, keeping owners aligned and following through on open items.
- Provide administrative support for certain Luxembourg-related matters and coordinate with the relevant internal and external contacts.
- Escalate delays, missing information, unclear ownership or material issues to the CFO or relevant functional lead.

Requirements & Qualifications

- Professional fluency in English, with the ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally with internal and external stakeholders.
- Experience in an administrative, executive support, banking, legal operations, paralegal, corporate services or similar coordination role.
- Strong organisation and follow-through, with the confidence to chase people, manage deadlines and keep multiple workstreams moving.
- Experience handling confidential information and formal documentation with accuracy and discretion.
- Comfort working with banks, lawyers, advisers, notaries, corporate service providers or other external stakeholders.
- Ability to work independently, prioritise changing requests and operate with flexibility when the CFO and key stakeholders are based in another country.
- Good judgement and attention to detail when coordinating governance, KYC/AML, banking and legal entity administration.

Nice to have

- Professional proficiency in French.
- Experience supporting a CFO, finance leader, executive team or European corporate function.
- Experience in a bank, financial institution, law office, corporate services provider or multinational business.
- Familiarity with KYC/AML processes, bank mandates, signatory administration, powers of attorney, board documentation or legal entity management.
- Experience coordinating entity closures, corporate reorganisations, acquisitions or other cross-border projects.
- Familiarity with Luxembourg corporate or finance administration.

How you’ll work

This role is about making sure important administrative and governance work does not sit unresolved. You will often be coordinating several parties at once, clarifying what is needed, tracking who owns the next step and following up until the document, approval, bank request or entity action is complete.

You will work closely with Finance and Legal, but you are not expected to provide accounting or legal advice. Your value will come from being dependable, organised and persistent, and from creating enough structure that the CFO and specialist advisers can make decisions and complete formalities efficiently.

The role requires flexibility in working hours to accommodate cross-border coordination with the CFO in France, banks, advisers and teams in other time zones.

Why join Atari

This role sits at the centre of an international finance and governance environment. You will work across Germany, France, Luxembourg and other Atari Group locations, helping coordinate the formalities and projects that support the Group’s entities and operations.

You will have visibility across Finance, Legal and senior leadership, with the opportunity to build a reliable operating rhythm for corporate administration and cross-border coordination as Atari continues to integrate and develop its international business.

What awaits you? It's up to you! At Dr. Oetker, you can actively shape the future - both yours and ours. We want to be part of something bigger. Don't you?

JOIN THE TASTE.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- As an Application Product Owner - Innovation Management (m/f/d), you will support and develop the Clarity application. This involves analysing business requirements, developing suitable system solutions, and ensuring the application is user-friendly and business processes are mapped efficiently.
- Your responsibilities will include identifying and implementing opportunities to optimise existing processes and structures. In addition, you will contribute to application-related working groups and projects.
- You will coordinate rollouts, system changes, and new functionalities. Furthermore, you will advise and support users on business-related topics and resolve application issues by developing appropriate solutions.
- You will also be responsible for creating and maintaining training materials, system documentation, and user guides, as well as conducting training sessions and workshops.
- Working closely with the IT and Application Management teams, as well as external service providers, you will gather, analyse, and document business requirements. You will prioritize enhancement requests, create functional concepts and test cases, and support business testing activities as well as the implementation of new functionalities.
- With a focus on data quality and reporting, you will support business departments in maintaining high standards of data quality. You will analyse data, create standard reports and dashboards, identify data inconsistencies, and contribute to the further development of reporting and analytics capabilities.
- In collaboration with various business functions, IT, and other stakeholders, you will help ensure the efficient use of systems, identify and implement improvement measures, and contribute ideas for the further development of existing processes and applications. You will also actively participate in cross-functional projects.

WHAT YOU BRING

- You have successfully completed a degree in Business Informatics, Business Administration, Innovation Management, or a related subject with a focus on IT applications, business processes, project management, or digital solutions.
- You have several years of professional experience in Application Management, Product Ownership, Project Management, or a comparable role focused on the support and continuous improvement of business applications.
- Ideally, you have knowledge of project and portfolio management, as well as experience with Clarity or similar applications. In addition, you are familiar with innovation management processes, such as Idea2Launch, Stage-Gate-processes, or similar frameworks.
- You are proficient in agile, hybrid and demand management methodologies, including backlog prioritisation, release planning, and value-driven product development. You are experienced in developing product visions and roadmaps and translating business strategies into scalable system solutions, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
- You have a strong affinity for data governance, portfolio transparency, reporting analytics, and data-driven decision-making. Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills distinguish you.
- You think strategically, analytically, and commercially, and work a in structured, pragmatic, and solution-oriented manner. Furthermore, you have a proven ability to prioritise competing requirements effectively, derive sound business cases and make recommendations.
- Excellent German and English language skills would complete your profile.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

- Attractive remuneration
- Flexible work models & mobile work
- 30 days of vacation plus Special vacation at Christmas & New Year's Eve
- Onboarding and professional development opportunities
- Excellent employee restaurant and discounts in the Dr. Oetker Shop
- Events and celebrations ​
- Sports, health and fitness offers
- Pension plan, Sabbatical and JobRad
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP), this offers professional support in all situations, such as assistance with childcare, finding au pairs, and advice on care services
- Daycare cooperation for children, holiday childcare and laundry service

Company Description

About Redcare Pharmacy:
As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy, Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy, collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values, join us and begin your #Redcareer today.
Conduct an AI interview with our digital Recruiting Assistant Reddi — anytime, anywhere!
As soon as you submit your application, you will receive a link via email for the first interview.
About the role:
Join our team as a Warehouse Worker (m/f/d) on weekends, for at least 3 Sundays in a month, in the early shift from 06:00 - 14:00 or in the late shift  from 14:00 - 22:00 o'clock and shape the future of healthcare logistics!
Job Description

About your tasks: ✓ You will handle incoming goods and store all incoming products, distributing them appropriately in our warehouse ✓ You will precisely pick our products, ensuring the complete processing of customer orders ✓ You will carefully pack customer orders and guarantee a smooth shipping✓
You carry out regular quality checks and ensure that damaged or faulty products are identified and removed at an early stage✓
You keep your work area organized and clean, contributing to a safe and efficient warehouse environment

Qualifications

About you:  ✓ You are an EU citizen or hold a Dutch work permit ✓ You can understand and speak German or English without difficulty ✓ You have a driver’s license and a car or motorcycle, etc., to commute independently to the workplace in Sevenum (Note: There is no public transport connection) ✓ You are able to perform a standing job for up to 8 hours a day and walk more than 15,000 steps ✓ You don’t need prior warehouse experience, as long as you are willing to learn new tasks

Additional Information

About our benefits:
In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs – whether it’s living a healthy life, having enough time for your needs, or developing your skills – we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits:   ✓
Mobility: Not all employees live close to our office. That’s why we support our employees with your daily commute with a travel allowance. This compensation is paid to you with 25 cents per kilometer in addition to your net salary.  ✓
Redcare events: We promote team-building through creative team events, and celebrate our successes together at regularly scheduled parties.  ✓
Sunday Bonus: 50%✓
Employee discount: Several times a year, we offer you discounted employee sales directly at the Sevenum location as well as 10 % off on our assortment for all employees.  ✓
Employee referral program: Because our employees know best who fits in with us, successful recommendations are rewarded with a bonus.
